note: Package 3b: the personal settings layer, the commit policy by environment, hooks that fire once, and the small items of docs/plan/package-3b.md. Contract: .claude/architecture/feature/engine-package-3b.md. One slice = one commit on unattended/2026-10-02-package-3b. S7-S9 are owner-only and parked from the start with their exact unblocking step.

nodes.title: personal-layer: user/settings.json, engine.py install --personal, the parity check, the proposed shared settings.json (tracer bullet)
hooks-fire-once: the personal layer wires no hooks; an engine hook outside the project stands down when the project wires its own copy
commit-policy-by-environment: env-probe.sh, cloud commit switch (ships off), commit_checkpoint.sh keeps a suffixed branch and commits the index as staged
narrow-root-delete-deny: rm -fr/-rf parity, a reference matcher for Bash permission rules, the narrowed deny list in the proposal
install-name-collision: install.sh refuses a user skill named like an engine skill; the prefix for new personal skills
docs-and-records: docs/engine-limits.md, the personal layer in TEMPLATE-SETUP.md, the stale escalation closed, the ownership map, the macOS baseline
apply-shared-settings (OWNER): copy docs/tasks/settings.json over .claude/settings.json
nodes.parked_on: protect-paths.sh refuses .claude/settings.json to the agent by design. Unblocks when the owner runs the one command in docs/tasks/README.md and the proposal test passes against the live file.

nodes.title: apply-personal (OWNER): engine.py install --personal against the real ~/.claude
nodes.parked_on: The run may only dry-run against ~/.claude. Unblocks when the owner runs `python3 engine.py install --personal --ref unattended/2026-10-02-package-3b` after reading its --dry-run.

nodes.title: cloud-probe (OWNER): run .claude/unattended/env-probe.sh in a real cloud session, then decide CLOUD_COMMIT_POLICY
nodes.parked_on: Only a real cloud session can produce the facts. Unblocks when the owner pastes the probe's output back; the switch stays off until then.
